raw_definitions: Definisi : adj 1. separating into different directions, (men)capah: ~ lines, garisan-garisan capah; 2. deviating, ( lit. & fig. ) menyimpang: ~ behaviour, tingkah laku yg menyimpang; 3. different, berbeza: ~ ideas on morality, idea-idea yg berbeza ttg kemoralan. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
